const.GENESIS: Only the legal initial or successor genesis admission closure can establish identity; exact initialization namespace, roots and union-DAG rules apply.
const.E0_READY: All current exact bootstrap, source, environment and E0 readiness prerequisites independently pass.
const.AUDIT_START: Exact current source/policy and legally ready required ordinary-stage plan; no skipped prerequisite.
const.BLOCK_OR_CANCEL: Truthful independently supported blocker/failure or authenticated administrative cancellation; no assurance upgrade.
const.STOP_BLOCKED: Exact applicable prior StopEvaluation has BLOCKED at the declared intermediate/final/post-E6 context; complete reasons retained.
const.E6_REQUIRED: Exact applicable prior final/post-E6 StopEvaluation has E6_REQUIRED and supplies the legally required continuation scope.
const.E6_START: Prior E6_REQUIRED decision and applicable accepted continuation plan/budget/authorizations; unknown prerequisites reject.
const.FINAL_PASS_CONCLUSION: Prior current final/post-E6 StopEvaluation PASS and independently lawful accepted CampaignConclusion COMPLETED, complete required stages/candidate/challengers and no omitted material blocker. Conclusion may be an earlier content dependency in the same atomic accepting command only if its exact reference class permits; STOP/context/approval prerequisites are prior-only.
const.LIMITED_CONCLUSION: Exact lawful accepted limited conclusion with separate required prior owner approval and complete unresolved-material disclosure. AUDIT_RUNNING/E6_RUNNING require the exact applicable BLOCKED STOP; E6_REQUIRED requires its existing E6_REQUIRED basis; BLOCKED requires complete exact limited-conclusion basis. Only COMPLETED_LIMITED; no PASS/full assurance or false release readiness. Same-command conclusion content is allowed only by its exact reference class and acyclic atomic order, never by future reference.
const.RESOLVE_CAMPAIGN_BLOCKER: Exact resolved_blocker_refs prove all blocking facts remediated; unchanged source/policy and accepted ResolveBlocker/ReopenCampaign. New STOP required before any success conclusion.
const.CAMPAIGN_CLOSE: Prior accepted lawful CampaignConclusion and required finalization/report/close prerequisites; cancellation cannot fabricate conclusion authority.
const.RUN_READY: Exact run/spec/source, predecessor outputs and planned slot prerequisites; independent knowledge/isolation/gate predicates pass.
const.RUN_START: Ready exact run with active lawful campaign/parent, source and required authority; no terminal predecessor mutation.
const.INPUT_WAIT: Current exact source/run and independently observed required-input availability state; waiting does not satisfy missing outputs.
const.COMPLETION_CANDIDATE: All spec-required result/output slots supplied through their lawful accepted chains; candidate status is not completion qualification.
const.COMPLETION_ACCEPT: Independent complete L1-L7 lane/stage completion predicates, current cut/source, exact slots, knowledge/isolation, required outputs, accounting and evidence applicability.
const.RETURN_TO_RUNNING: Independent current evidence demonstrates completion-candidate prerequisites are not satisfied; no accepted completion revision is mutated.
const.SUPERSEDE: Authenticated exact prior-run/attempt supersession with lawful reason/current cut; no replacement of historical binding/results or retroactive execution.
const.ATTEMPT_START: Exact prior assignment and unique prior durable package binding in a separate earlier commit; CREATED active attempt, current source/grants/knowledge/isolation. Delivery remains separately guarded.
const.RESULT_RECEIVE: Trusted independent result raw admission, exact prior assignment/binding/STARTED, active declared slot and current input cut; caller command kind/token/body assertions confer no authority.
const.RESULT_ACCEPT: Prior accepted admission evidence in an earlier commit and exact independent retained-byte normalization; active slot/source/attempt and current result cut. No same-commit shortcut.
const.ATTEMPT_FAILURE: Truthful supported execution failure/blocker under current exact context; cannot create result/completion authority.
